band_rule: [paper - 0.15, 1]: the paper's single unseeded run gives no spread; the margin covers the digitisation / resolution sensitivity of the paper's own map (rho 0.769-0.805 over grids 20 / 41 / 101) and run-to-run variation of a bootstrapped γ = 0.99 model; the lower bound stays far above the myopic reference (0.204), so a model without long-horizon prediction cannot pass. Upper bound 1: agreeing with the ground truth more closely than the paper's figure is not a reproduction failure.

myopic_reference.meaning: a value map equal to the one-step reward (no long-horizon prediction)

paper.source: Janner, Mordatch, Levine, γ-Models: Generative Temporal Difference Learning for Infinite-Horizon Prediction, NeurIPS 2020 (arXiv 2010.14496v4), Fig. 4 (pendulum, γ = 0.99: 'Value estimates' vs 'Ground truth' = value iteration on a discretisation)

pass_rule: pass iff the run's rho at n = 41 lies in the band (inclusive). One run (seed 0). At most two logged repair attempts, each fixing a diagnosed port / harness defect, never the band (P-fid); then T3 is dropped with fidelity_not_reproduced.

deviations: device cpu (notebook: cuda:0); torch 2.13.0 float32, 4 threads
seeds fixed: torch.manual_seed(0), np.random.seed(0) before the model cell (the notebook sets none)
in-loop visualisation cell body (every 100 steps: visualize + display_video) skipped: display only; it reads the model without touching parameters, optimizer or RNG; the loss is logged instead
save_model every 1000 steps replaced by a resumable checkpoint (model, target, optimizer, ActNorm init flags, numpy / torch RNG states, step) every 1000 steps and on SIGTERM / SIGUSR1 (exit 75)
